|lore=Flying fortress of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Reaches speeds of 800 kph in atmosphere. The crime lord installed hidden gunports as an unpleasant surprise for would-be pirates.
|game_text=May add 2 alien pilots and 6 passengers. When opponent initiates battle at same system, you may deploy as a ‘react’ (for free) with an Independent starship (and a pilot if that ship is unpiloted) from hand and/or Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition while Jabba aboard.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 3, slip 39 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “May add 2 alien pilots and 6 passengers. When opponent initiates battle at same system, you may deploy as a ‘react’ (for free) with an Independent starship (and a pilot if that ship is unpiloted) from hand and/or Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition while Jabba aboard.” Stats line: “POWER 5 ARMOR 5 HYPERSPEED 4”. Deploy 3, forfeit 6. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•39” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jabba's Space Cruiser (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 39), in the Committee's Remaster template: “May add 2 alien pilots and 6 passengers. May deploy an [Independent] starship (with a pilot aboard, if unpiloted) here from hand and/or Reserve Deck (for free) as a ‘react;’ reshuffle. If Jabba here, immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
